title: What explains public support for plastic policy? A comparative study of Nigeria and Ghana: data, code and outputs
description:
De-identified survey data, analysis code and every output for the article What explains public support for plastic policy? A comparative study of Nigeria and Ghana.

Contents: the merged, de-identified survey file (740 respondents: Nigeria 481, Ghana 259; 70 variables) with a data dictionary; the open-ended codebook and a 120-answer coder validation sample; a single Jupyter notebook (Python 3.13 and R 4.3.3, fixed random seeds, pinned package versions) that reproduces every table and figure; and all tables (CSV and Excel), figures (600-dpi PNG and TIFF, vector PDF), lavaan model summaries and R logs.

The raw Google Forms exports are not included because they contain exact submission times and free-text occupations; the notebook runs from the de-identified file.
